{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693794746,"sessionID":"ses_e23ebae45ffe5atj76t70ElBnV","part":{"id":"prt_1dc160a3b001oABZlz0xS7Idy9","messageID":"msg_1dc15e729001wvaNZEMpfdmcd3","sessionID":"ses_e23ebae45ffe5atj76t70ElBnV","type":"text","text":"The shift is over. I found and fixed four separate faults, and all four customer-facing services were at 0% errors from minute 69 until the shift ended at minute 120. Nothing new broke in that time. I didn't throttle anything, and every service I scaled up is back to its normal replica count.\n\n| # | Root cause | What customers saw | Fix | Back to normal |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Deploy `v80` on **ledger-svc** (minute −16) divided the call deadline by 10,000 instead of 1,000. Calls failed, and callers' retries overloaded the service at about 3.5× its normal traffic. | Through push-svc, media-svc and suggest-svc: web-storefront at 92% errors, mobile-api at 97%, partner-api at 27% | Rolled back the deploy and temporarily went from 3 to 6 replicas to absorb the retries, then back to 3 | ~minute 30 |\n| 2 | Deploy `v66` on **suggest-svc** (minute −128) had a memory leak. Memory climbed steadily to 99% and the process kept crashing and restarting. | Part of the mobile-api failures | Rolled back the deploy | ~minute 34 |\n| 3 | Deploy `v116` on **profile-db** (minute −26) changed `row.get(\"currency\",\"EUR\")` to `row[\"currency\"]`, so it failed on rows with no currency. profile-db's own metrics looked healthy, but recommendations-svc and disputes-svc saw about 4% of calls fail. | admin-portal at 4% errors, about $850/min lost because it earns $21,300/min | Went from 4 to 6 replicas before the rollback so retries during it wouldn't overload the database, rolled back, then returned to 4 | ~minute 59 |\n| 4 | Config change `cfg-44` on **labels-svc** started during the shift (minute 57) and cut `rate_limit_per_s` from 5000 to 50. | mobile-api at 88% errors | Reverted the config | ~minute 68 |\n\nAll the other alerts and recent changes I looked at were symptoms or harmless, so I didn't touch them. For example, media-svc's high CPU settled by itself once ledger-svc was fixed.\n\nThe main cost driver was admin-portal's 4% error rate until about minute 59. It's small as a percentage but expensive at $21,300/min. In hindsight I should have chased it first, since it was costing more per minute than the three larger outages combined.","time":{"start":1794693794364,"end":1794693794744}}}
